response.text:
I can do that, but I need a couple quick confirmations so I don’t do the wrong destructive action.

1) Operation — archive or delete?
- Archive: removes messages from Inbox but keeps them in All Mail (reversible, searchable).
- Delete: moves to Trash (removed from Trash after ~30 days unless you empty it).

2) Exact target and scope — please choose one:
- A: All messages from noreply@transitalerts.net (every message).
- B: Only messages older than a cutoff (specify e.g., 90 days, 1 year).
- C: Only unread, or only read, or only not-starred/important (specify).
- D: Only messages matching additional text (subject contains, label, etc.).

3) Exceptions — do you want to preserve starred/important messages or messages with attachments? (yes / no)

4) Future handling — do you want me to also create a Gmail filter so future messages from that sender are auto-archived or deleted? (suggested: auto-archive)

If that’s fine, reply with a confirmation that includes:
- operation (archive or delete),
- scope choice (A/B/C/D and details),
- whether to preserve starred/important/attachments,
- whether to create a future filter.

Example confirmation you can copy/paste:
"Confirm: archive all messages from noreply@transitalerts.net older than 90 days; preserve starred; create filter to auto-archive future messages."

Once you confirm like that, I’ll proceed.
